slices.intention: compile pinned native child workflows through generated immutable registry bindings and honest lifecycle semantics

compatibilityRisks: A child registry key resolves a mutable or mismatched version
Mapped child args override principal identity or exceed component limits
Cancellation or asynchronous cleanup is described as rollback or immediate deletion
existingModuleRepairChecklist.promptVersioningImpact: The exact child version, stable runWorkflow step name, principal posture, and lifecycle declaration are immutable workflow-version inputs.

workPackages.target: WP-1.4 native subworkflow registry and executor
workPackages.templateResolutionPath: Promote the generated subworkflow registry and typed executor now; defer events, ownership-link persistence, and generator central wiring to their ordered WP-1.4 slices.

slices.rationale: An unscheduled child can safely execute only after its generated key, exact version, args budget, principal narrowing, result validator, and component lifecycle posture are fixed.
